# The CommonMark specification, vendored as the classifier's input.
#
# source:   https://raw.githubusercontent.com/commonmark/commonmark-spec/0.31.2/spec.txt
# version:  0.31.2 (dated 2024-01-28 in the document's own front matter)
# fetched:  2026-09-25
# sha256:   257c41ad946f7a1414a499aca402a1aa8fdac3678532266611348c1cf54f4b80
# license:  CC-BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/),
#           declared by the document's front matter; author John MacFarlane.
# examples: 652, each delimited by a line of exactly 32 backticks followed by
#           " example", the markdown and the expected HTML separated by a
#           line holding a single ".", closed by 32 backticks. Tabs in an
#           example body are written as the two characters "→" (U+2192) and
#           restored by the reader.
#
# Vendored whole rather than pre-extracted so this sha256 is the thing a
# reader checks: the extraction is code (scripts/commonmark.lean, its
# --selftest covers it) and code is reviewable, while a pre-extracted file
# would be a second artifact nobody can verify against upstream.
#
# Section headings are "## " lines *outside* an example block. Counting them
# naively finds 39; six of those are inside examples (the spec documents ATX
# headings by writing them), so the reader tracks example boundaries.

# The GitHub Flavored Markdown specification, vendored for its table extension.
#
# source:   https://raw.githubusercontent.com/github/cmark-gfm/27d942c8b0a62d192f616e5bf3578f4b6a89e180/test/spec.txt
#           (cmark-gfm at commit 27d942c8b0a62d192f616e5bf3578f4b6a89e180, its
#           master on 2026-10-08; byte-identical to the file at tag 0.29.0.gfm.13)
# file:     gfm-spec-0.29.txt, the upstream bytes unchanged
# version:  0.29-gfm (dated 2019-04-06 in the document's own front matter)
# fetched:  2026-10-08
# sha256:   7d8e5814befec287ac116786d81ff14e0adc9b13295b4494649e995408fd871c
# license:  CC-BY-SA 4.0, declared by the document's front matter; the legal code
#           is LICENSE-CC-BY-SA-4.0.txt beside this file (fetched 2026-10-08 from
#           https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/legalcode.txt), and
#           covers spec-0.31.2.txt too.
# examples: 672, delimited as in the CommonMark spec; an extension's example
#           names it after the word "example" ("example table").
#
# What is read: the eight examples of "## Tables (extension)" (198-205 in the
# document's own numbering), the one GFM construct the engine's surface AST
# expresses. What is left: the other 664. Most are CommonMark 0.29 examples
# that spec-0.31.2.txt already classifies at a later version; the strikethrough,
# task-list, extended-autolink and tag-filter extensions are constructs this
# dialect does not read, and classifying them would only count owed cases.
#
# SHA256SUMS covers both specs and the legal code: `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS`
# from this directory. The classifier gates on an in-Lean content key instead,
# so its check needs no host tool.
